certified_red_crossing.formula: same-tick certified red phase and exact route stop-line; full front-edge swept geometry from interval start to end; unthresholded crossing independent of speed

collision.formula: full frozen ego/actor OBB polygon intersection per tick; run collision_any=any(I), episodes=sum(false_to_true), duration_s=sum(I)*0.1

formula.drac: closing^2/(2*max(clearance,1e-9)) only when closing>0 and clearance>0; collision is separate
formula.geometry_ttc: continuous SAT entry time under constant-velocity translation of the two frozen OBBs only when centroid dot(r,v_rel)<0 and entry_time<=5.0s

goal.formula: independent of route projection; reached when same-tick distance<=frozen goal_tolerance_m; passed when the same tick is within frozen goal_pass_window_m and the goal lies behind the frozen ego heading

latency.formula: per-run empirical mean/median/p95/p99/max by native stage; deadline exceedance_rate=count(total>D)/64

road_containment.formula: outside_fraction=area(F_t minus union(D_t))/area(F_t); offroad_any=any(outside_fraction>1e-9); exposed union boundary is reconstructed by splitting root-bound polygon edges at all intersections and removing internal overlap/adjacency seams; signed clearance is positive minimum full-footprint-boundary distance when contained and negative maximum footprint-boundary penetration when outside

route.formula: stateful ordered-route segment projection with same/adjacent forward-or-backward transitions and max(trapezoidal speed distance,sealed position displacement)+1e-6m travel bound; completion=clip(max_forward/route_length,0,1)

vehicle_body_planar_kinematic_proxy.formula: 64 positions -> 63 interval velocities -> 62 accelerations; rotate by corresponding heading; 11-point centered equal-weight zero-phase valid-only boxcar -> 52; filtered jerk diff/0.1 -> 51
